_doc: Which canonical jobs (game/data/canonical/jobs.json) are playable in this build and what advancing grants (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 9). A job missing here is not playable with default_reason. Optional level overrides the canonical advancement level for survivor mode; an option above the player's level shows level_reason instead. grants.max_mp adds to computed base Max MP (Improved MaxMP Increase preserves the current MP ratio on growth). grants.max_hp (added to base Max HP, like level growth) is supported alongside max_mp. format1_weapon (tier C, frozen spec #32 rule) is the weapon CharacterSnapshot.migrate gives a format-1 character of that job line, the nearest ancestor's entry; new jobs need none. paths (first jobs, spec #151 #157): [{id, label, item_id, family}], one job-window entry each; taking one records it on the character (snapshot weapon_path) and grants and wears its item_id without requirement checks (tier B Beginner weapons given by the instructors; Warrior has none and keeps its creation weapon, Magician's Wooden Wand is balance.player.weapon_grants). weapon_families + grant_item (second jobs): the families the branch can use and the weapon worn when the held one is not among them (tier C); grant_item ids are chosen by the class specs, so a row without one grants nothing. No job grants skills. Accepting a job opens an extra advancement skill draw before the level's normal draw; canonical skill prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31).
